pick.name: Nano Banana in Gemini app / Flow (Google AI Pro)
pick.what: Google's image generation + editing (Nano Banana family) with strong text rendering and multi-image edits
pick.why: Already paid till Jan 2028, top-tier editing and consistency, and Google does not claim ownership of outputs.
pick.free_limits: AI Pro: 'expanded' image limits on the shared compute meter (4x standard, 5-h refresh, weekly cap); no fixed daily count published. Visible watermark on non-Ultra Gemini-app images; SynthID invisible watermark on all
pick.license: Google ToS (effective 30 Jul 2026: 'Google won't claim ownership')

alts.name: Recraft
alts.what: Image + vector generation with brand styles
alts.why: Best when you need SVG output or consistent brand style sets; paid for commercial rights.
alts.free_limits: Free: images public, owned by Recraft, not for commercial use

alts.name: Ideogram
alts.why: Best text-in-image layouts; pricing page blocked our fetch.

decision: Nano Banana is already in the plan and leads on editing; Flow is the place to generate without the Gemini-app visible watermark if Flow outputs are unmarked (unverified). Pay for Recraft only when you need vector output.
details: Visible watermark removal is Ultra-only per coverage of the Nano Banana Pro launch.

verify.note: Same Gemini limits page: image generation (Nano Banana 2) included with Pro on the shared 4x/5-h/weekly meter.
